articles.title: Pancreatic SBRT in Italian Clinical Practice: A Multicenter Analysis of 473 Patients Treated in 17 Centers
articles.summary: This multicenter study evaluated the safety and efficacy of stereotactic body radiation therapy (SBRT) for pancreatic cancer. Findings suggest that ablative dose delivery and MR-guided radiotherapy (MRgRT) improve local control and organ-at-risk protection in non-metastatic patients.

articles.title: Vascular and Circulating Blood Exposure to Proton or Photon Irradiation: Differentials in Lymphocyte Subset Metrics in Cancer Patients
articles.summary: This study demonstrates that patient-specific vascular delineation and dosimetry are feasible in clinical planning workflows. The resulting metrics track the irradiation modality and correlate with the magnitude of lymphocyte depletion.

articles.title: In Silico Dosimetric Comparison of Intensity-Modulated Photon Versus Proton Therapy for Pelvic and Para-Aortic Nodal Recurrence of Prostate Cancer Following Prior Irradiation
articles.summary: This comparative study evaluates the dosimetric differences between VMAT and intensity-modulated proton therapy (IMPT) for patients with nodal recurrence of prostate cancer in the re-irradiation setting.

articles.title: Optimization and Performance Assessment of a Low-Dose Alanine Electron Paramagnetic Resonance Dosimetry Procedure for Potential Application in Electron Beam FLASH Radiotherapy
articles.summary: This work explores the optimization of alanine EPR measurement procedures to improve accuracy and reduce uncertainty for dose measurements below 10 Gy, a key requirement for future FLASH radiotherapy applications.

articles.title: Pre-selection of breast cancer patients for deep inspiration breath-hold proton radiotherapy: Who benefits?
articles.summary: This study evaluates which breast cancer patients derive the greatest benefit from intensity-modulated proton therapy using deep inspiration breath-hold. Researchers highlight specific criteria, such as patient age, tumor side, and cardiac risk factors, to guide personalized treatment planning.

articles.title: Improved breast DIBH simulation efficiency and dosimetry with a take-home wireless respiration belt coaching system
articles.summary: Researchers demonstrate that a take-home wireless respiration coaching system significantly reduces CT simulation time for breast cancer patients. The intervention also correlated with improved cardiac dose metrics compared to standard methods.

articles.title: Efficient proton adaptive breast radiotherapy with CBCT-Based synthetic CT
articles.summary: The study demonstrates that synthetic CT can effectively identify tissue changes during breast proton therapy, helping to determine when targeted re-planning is necessary while avoiding unnecessary repetitive CT scans.

articles.title: Data-driven evaluation of quantitative metrics and models for normal-tissue sparing in FLASH radiotherapy
articles.summary: This paper provides a systematic benchmark of current models and metrics used to predict normal-tissue sparing in FLASH radiotherapy, comparing theoretical proposals against extensive in vivo data.

articles.title: Case series of adaptive pelvic radiotherapy using ETHOS: Lessons from two clinical examples
articles.summary: A technical note detailing clinical experiences with the ETHOS adaptive radiotherapy system, focusing on monitor unit variations and hotspot management during pelvic treatment. The report provides practical strategies for clinicians managing adaptive optimization.

articles.title: Experimental and Monte Carlo validation of DIN 6809-4:2020 kilovoltage X-ray beam qualities for secondary standard dosimetry applications
articles.summary: This study establishes an experimental and Monte Carlo-based framework for the validation of kilovoltage radiotherapy beam qualities. The work provides essential data to ensure accuracy in superficial lesion treatment dosimetry.

articles.title: Image quality and artefact reduction for tantalum clips in ocular proton therapy using photon-counting CT
articles.summary: This research finds that photon-counting CT combined with iterative metal artifact reduction improves image quality in ocular proton therapy, though tantalum clips remain a challenge for treatment planning.

articles.title: CY 2027 Medicare Final Rules and Impact on Proton Therapy
articles.summary: The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) released final rules for CY 2027, which take effect January 1, 2027. The rules include a significant increase in hospital outpatient payments for most proton therapy services due to budget-neutral redistribution related to 340B drug payment reductions.

articles.title: Clinical outcomes and toxicity after proton- versus photon-based spatially fractionated radiotherapy for soft-tissue sarcoma: a retrospective cohort
articles.summary: This retrospective analysis compares proton-based and photon-based spatially fractionated radiotherapy for high-grade soft-tissue sarcoma. The study explores how the Bragg peak characteristics of protons affect proximal skin dose and perioperative wound complications.

articles.title: BayCare Proton Center Treats First Patient on Mevion S250 FIT™ with Leo Cancer Care's Marie® Solution
articles.summary: The BayCare Proton Center has successfully initiated patient treatments using the Mevion S250 FIT proton therapy system integrated with Leo Cancer Care's Marie solution. This installation marks a new technological implementation in a clinical setting for advanced proton delivery.

articles.title: 50 million Americans live in counties without a radiation oncology clinic, study finds
articles.summary: A recent study highlights that 50 million Americans reside in counties lacking a radiation oncology clinic, underscoring significant geographic disparities in access to cancer care. The findings emphasize the ongoing challenges in providing equitable radiation treatment coverage across the United States.

articles.title: ASTRO updates guideline on shorter-course radiation therapy for localized prostate cancer
articles.summary: The American Society for Radiation Oncology (ASTRO) has updated its clinical guidelines regarding the use of shorter-course radiation therapy for patients with localized prostate cancer. The update reflects evolving clinical evidence on hypofractionated treatment regimens.

articles.title: IBA treats first patient in clinical trial of FLASH proton therapy for head and neck cancer
articles.summary: IBA has announced the treatment of the first patient in the C-FLASH-01 clinical trial, evaluating the safety and efficacy of ConformalFLASH proton therapy. This trial marks a significant milestone in testing ultra-high dose rate radiation delivery for head and neck cancer patients.

articles.title: Hampton University Proton Cancer Institute opens new wellness space
articles.summary: The Hampton University Proton Cancer Institute has inaugurated a new wellness facility dedicated to supporting patients and their caregivers. This regional development enhances the supportive care infrastructure at this key proton therapy center in the DMV area.
